sprites.name: generator
sprites.prompt: Use the supplied blue concept sheet as the design and palette reference. Create ONE isolated game sprite only, no sheet, no other objects from the reference, no text, no labels, no numbers, no border. Genuine transparent background. Match its rounded bright painted 2.5D casual merge-game style, clear rich cobalt blue with sky-blue highlights, honey wood, warm brass, cream and red accents. Three-quarter view slightly from above, soft upper-left light. Large simple shapes readable in a 48-pixel cell, clean silhouette. Entire object centered with 8% empty margin, no cropped parts, minimal contact shadow and no background plane. Subject: the wooden open toolbox generator at top left of the reference. Honey wood handle and rim, cobalt blue enamel side panels, one brass latch, red screwdriver and silver wrench peeking out, one tiny golden magical glimmer inside. Preserve the reference design.
